goals.summary: Instantiate cached HTML templates with document.importNode so their assembled nodes start in the page document, avoiding the reported Chromium template-document adoption sequence.

facets.summary: The reported Chromium behavior may leave a viewport listener in the template document retaining a removed responsive image and detached subtree.
The author states that importing template nodes into the page document up front prevents the T→M→T→M adoption sequence.
The change is presented as addressing Chromium retention of responsive images.

goals.summary: Add regression coverage for responsive images assembled through anchor fragments.
Add a patch changeset for the fix.
Preserve the stated reproduction and test evidence as review context, including Chromium CDP retention measurements and the reported project test, lint, check, and format runs.

facets.summary: The author reports a Playwright Chromium CDP reproduction in which forced garbage collection retained substantially more nodes for cloneNode subtrees than for importNode.
The author reports successful runtime-runes and full test runs, plus lint, check, and format commands.
